title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-14
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a solid early‑1970 set, highlighted by a stellar Not Fade Away → Mason’s Children → Caution → Feedback sequence and Pigpen’s acoustic Katie Mae.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear soundboard mix with Phil Lesh brought forward in the balance and Bobby Weir well‑defined, delivering an exceptionally listenable document. Musically the show shines with a cosmic Not Fade Away > Mason’s Children > Caution > Feedback stretch, a superb ABYGN jam and a memorable acoustic Katie Mae by Pigpen, even though some fans lament missing portions that appear on Dick's Picks IV. Overall the performance is regarded as great, with only minor complaints about a long‑winded drum segment and incomplete track listings.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give high scores (4–5 stars) and praise both the musical performance and the soundboard quality, while a few low‑star comments focus on missing songs rather than audio or playing issues. Weighted average of show (70%) and recording (30%) yields ~4.6.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix described as 'resoundingly exceptional' with clear instrument separation, Phil Lesh up‑front, balanced Bobby Weir and overall crisp soundboard fidelity.

standout_songs: Not Fade Away > Mason's Children > Caution (Do Not Stop) > Feedback
show_quality.setlist_flow: The show is considered slightly less strong than the previous night but still great; a 12‑minute drum segment is long‑winded, yet the cosmic jam sequence and acoustic moments keep the momentum high.

band_member_comments.Phil: Mix puts Phil up front; his bass on 'Hard To Handle' called 'next level' by a reviewer.
band_member_comments.Drums: A 12‑minute drum segment noted as long‑winded but part of the overall experience.
